tagline: Van rental application showcasing advanced routing, protected routes, and dashboard-based navigation.

details.overview: VanLife is a React single-page application built to explore advanced routing concepts including nested routes, protected routes, dynamic URLs, and shared layouts. The project focuses on application structure, navigation patterns, and scalable frontend architecture.
engineering_challenges: Designing a scalable nested routing structure
Implementing protected routes and authentication flows
Managing dynamic route parameters and data loading
Creating reusable layouts across multiple pages
what_i_learned: Advanced React Router concepts and routing patterns
Structuring larger React applications with nested layouts
Building maintainable navigation and page architecture
